page.meta_description: Theropoda is the saurischian clade of hollow-boned bipeds: Allosaurus, Velociraptor, Tyrannosaurus, and the line that becomes Aves. Related pages:…
page.content:
Bipedal mostly carnivorous dinosaurs, including birds.

How Theropoda connects

  • Item: Tyrannosaurus rex — Tyrannosaurus rex is a large coelurosaur theropod.
  • Topic: Saurischia — Theropods are the bipedal predators and birds inside Saurischia.
  • Topic: Birds — Living birds are nested inside Theropoda.
  • Item: Velociraptor — Velociraptor is a dromaeosaurid theropod.
  • Item: Allosaurus — Allosaurus is the common large theropod of the Morrison.
  • Item: Archaeopteryx — Archaeopteryx also sits on the theropod line that becomes birds.

What is Theropoda?

Theropoda is the saurischian clade of hollow-boned bipeds: Allosaurus, Velociraptor, Tyrannosaurus, and the line that becomes Aves.

Key threads lead to Tyrannosaurus rex, Saurischia, Birds, Velociraptor, Allosaurus and Archaeopteryx.
